features.history_scope: prior interactions from the official training split for this user and candidate author
features.time_order: strictly earlier interaction time than the current row ordered by time_ms
features.formula: (prior long_view positives for the user-candidate-author pair + 20 * global training long_view rate) / (prior pair interactions + 20)
features.rationale: Measures historical positive engagement with the candidate author.

features.history_scope: prior interactions from the official training split for this user and candidate author

features.formula: log1p(number of prior interactions between the user and candidate author)
features.rationale: Captures repeated exposure to the candidate author.
